title: Aladdin Tower

reconstruction.scope: Specific standing Aladdin mausoleum tower in Varamin: thirty-two sharp brick flutes, low conical brick cap, upper pointed corbel/blind-cell rhythm with sparse original geometric turquoise fragments, one small blind repair niche, projecting pale pointed entrance porch/stacked recesses/closed grilled doorway, and bounded buried footing. Four existing shared brick/stucco/tile/paint graphs; no copied calligraphy, photograph atlas, furnished tomb, assumed pristine full tile restoration, whole square or broad precinct slab.

reconstruction.heightBasis: Retained reported overall height26.71m has no point-of-measurement qualifier. The other16.11m statement is interior-qualified and is not used as exterior wall height. Picture-led nominal body/frieze shoulder20.1m, cone rise6.61m, upper frieze18.1..20.1m and porch7.6m guide the model. Parent map2m/circular-part7m values are unqualified component attributes, not adopted as total tower height. Roof/body split, flute depth, porch/repair niche, decorative/repair inventory and floor/foundation levels remain approximate.
reconstruction.terrainBasis: Retain original6m standard Mapzen grid, native paths/roads/water and all independent neighboring buildings. The broad named memorial parent and circular part are two representations of the same landmark; replace both generic shells. The model remains bounded to the tower and porch, leaving the rest of the named site as original ground rather than inventing a2m precinct slab. Small level footing sits just above the highest occupied rim, with buried sides below the lowest. No ground/water cutout or square flattening. The cropped ground photos and coarse DEM do not establish actual plaza/foundation engineering or a surveyed entrance azimuth.
